data.name: Kenan
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Kenan means 'Jehovah's gift'. In the Old Testament, Kenan is the name of a descendant of Adam and the father of Mahalalel. In the New Testament, a Kenan appears in the genealogy of Jesus Christ.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kenan has a rich cultural history that connects it to the biblical tradition. It is a unique and meaningful name, rooted in the ancient Hebrew language and the stories of the Old and New Testaments. It is a name that carries a sense of heritage and connection to the past, as well as a reminder of the continued influence of biblical stories and figures in our modern world.

It is a name that invites us to reflect on the sacredness of our existence and to give thanks for the blessings we have received. It also serves as a reminder of the continuity of faith and the eternal nature of God's love and grace, as evidenced by the name's appearance in both the Old and New Testaments.
